name: Hamming Distance
description: Hamming distance between two strings of equal length is the number of positions at which the corresponding symbols are different. You are given two strings; calculate the distance between them.
input_specification: The input consists of two lines. Each line contains a string of characters ' A '-' Z ' between 1 and 100 characters, inclusive. The strings have equal length.
output_specification: Output Hamming distance between the strings.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
